question: For which deities must a provisional child image be prepared?
premises: Ritual continuity may require a substitute image.
All deities with form are included in this requirement.
A provisional child image serves this purpose.
inference: A provisional child image should be made for all deities with form.
uncertainties: sakalānāṃ may have a technical sense distinguishing embodied deities
plain_english: A provisional child image should be made for all deities with form.
